parsed.explanation: The quoted line is explicitly a conditional reduction ("it suffices"): it supplies no finite L and no proof that membership in S_infty is invariant under m -> m+L. The needed input is the finiteness/large-prime-erasure statement (L6.2), which the write-up itself lists as unproved ("Remaining crux: prove shrinkage stops"), supported only by empirics on 100+ values of a_1. Nothing elsewhere in the text produces a concrete L or proves residue-class structure for all m >= a_1; the conditional derivation of T = #(S_infty cap [1,L]) is fine but vacuous without it. Closing the gap requires a genuine new lemma, not a local edit.
